article: Choosing GitHub Copilot and local coding models by data boundaries and measured task requirements
findings: Removed stale Llama 3/CodeLlama/older Copilot recommendations and unsupported blanket cloud-versus-local security/performance claims; directs readers to live model catalogs and test-on-hardware guidance.

Corrected GitHub Copilot data handling by distinguishing individual plans, which may use interactions for training with an opt-out, from Business/Enterprise customer data, which GitHub says is not used for training without customer authorization; linked current policy and model-hosting docs.
Clarified local inference versus fully offline operation, including extension telemetry and pre-downloads, and distinguished Ollama localhost API from its hosted cloud endpoint.

Added task/data classification, routing examples, task-specific evaluation, total cost including local hardware and review, current Ollama/Continue configuration, least privilege, human approval, and prompt-injection caution.
Preserved original publication date 2026-09-11, added localized lastmod/descriptions, and compared Japanese with all twelve complete translations.

post/CopilotとローカルAIの使い分けで開発効率を爆上げする/inde.source: post/CopilotとローカルAIの使い分けで開発効率を爆上げする/index.md

meaning.note: Compared the complete edition with Japanese: cloud versus local processing paths, individual and organization Copilot policy distinction, Ollama local versus hosted endpoints, data classification, task routing examples, evaluation procedure, cost/hardware factors, Continue/Ollama setup, permissions, injection risks, and publication/update scope.

terminology.note: Checked localized terms for cloud and local inference, repository context, model hosting, telemetry, endpoint, data classification, retention, token/context length, quantization, GPU/VRAM, Ollama, Continue, tool calling, prompt injection, and human approval.

mathematics.note: The revised article contains no mathematical formulas, derivations, or numerical performance estimates.

code.note: Compared the same shell placeholder command and Continue YAML configuration across all editions: exact model tag/ID must be supplied by the reader, local API base is localhost, provider is ollama, and chat role is configured. Commands were reviewed against primary docs but not executed; no model was downloaded or API invoked.

links.note: Verified the common link set points to primary GitHub Copilot policy/model hosting, Continue offline/Ollama configuration, Ollama API, and Ollama model library documentation. Reachability and plan-specific organizational policy were not tested for each reader.
